title: Hair salon advertising ideas that boost bookings

facts.fact: The article is dated 10 September 2025 and has a stated reading time of 17 minutes.
The article title and headline promise 20 hair salon advertising ideas that work in 2026.
facts.quote: 20 proven hair salon advertising ideas: Examples, tips and high-converting copy that work in 2026

facts.fact: As an example offer for a Google Business Profile local offer post, the article suggests a new-client discount of $20 off a first color service.
facts.quote: Run a new-client offer like “$20 off first color service” and promote it monthly.
